title: History
description: What has happened to the tree over time: readings of key-result metrics, and the batches of edits that changed the structure. Schema only in v1 — nothing writes this yet.

metricSamples.description: Point-in-time readings of a node's metric, oldest first.

changes.description: Batches of edits applied to the tree, oldest first.

items.description: One batch of edits, applied together.

metricSample.title: MetricSample
metricSample.description: One reading of one node's metric.

nodeId.description: Id of the node the reading belongs to.

at.description: When the reading was taken, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

value.description: The measured value, in whatever unit the node's metric names.

note.description: Optional context for the reading, for example why it moved.

change.title: TreeChange
change.description: A batch of actions applied to the tree in one go, with who applied them and why.

at.description: When the batch was applied, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

actor.description: Who applied the batch: the user directly, the assistant, or an import.

reason.description: Plain-language explanation of the change, usually the assistant's reply.
